Insufficient Role Segregation in Cognito User Pool [Elevation of Privilege, Spoofing, CWE-269] on Cognito UserPool, IAM Roles, API Gateway: While IAM roles for authenticated and admin users are defined, the current implementation lacks Cognito Identity Pools and proper group-to-role mapping, potentially allowing users to assume incorrect roles. A regular user might manipulate their token claims or exploit misconfigured role assumption policies to gain admin privileges.

Insecure CORS Configuration in API Gateway and S3 [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-942] on API Gateway, S3 Dataplane Bucket, CloudFront Distribution: Overly permissive CORS policies allow any origin to make requests to the API and S3 bucket, potentially exposing sensitive data or enabling unauthorized modifications. An attacker hosts a malicious website that makes authenticated requests to the API or S3 bucket using stolen credentials, exploiting the permissive CORS policy.

Workflow Processing System Availability Risk [Denial of Service, CWE-404] on Workflow Processor Lambda, SQS Queue, Source Media Bucket: Lambda functions have execution time limits and memory constraints that may be insufficient for processing large media files, leading to timeouts and failed operations. An attacker could upload extremely large or malformed media files to overwhelm the workflow processor and cause service disruption.

Insufficient Monitoring and Logging of AI/ML Service Usage [Information Disclosure, Repudiation, CWE-223] on Operator Lambda, AI/ML Services, CloudWatch Logs: The operator Lambda has broad permissions to AI/ML services ('*' actions) and lacks detailed audit logging of service usage and data processing activities. An attacker gaining access to the operator Lambda could abuse AI/ML services to process unauthorized data or extract sensitive information without detection.

Insecure OpenSearch Domain Configuration [Information Disclosure, Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-284] on OpenSearch Domain, Analytics Lambda, Kinesis Stream: The OpenSearch domain is configured with basic master user authentication and is not deployed within a VPC, potentially exposing it to unauthorized access. An attacker could attempt to brute force the master user credentials or exploit network exposure to gain unauthorized access to analytics data.

Insufficient Protection Against Media File-Based Attacks [Tampering, Denial of Service, CWE-434] on Source Media Bucket, Workflow Processor Lambda, Operator Lambda, AI/ML Services: The system accepts media files without thorough validation of file types, contents, and metadata, potentially allowing malicious files to be processed. An attacker uploads a maliciously crafted media file that exploits vulnerabilities in media processing libraries or contains embedded malicious code.
